scope: Motor design-baseline decision and requirement documentation only

Checked relative Markdown link targets in all six modified Markdown files and git diff --check.

findings.issue: Manufacturer dimensions and mass describe the general GDS34 catalog configuration; the Pupper-specific revision has not been checked against a drawing.
findings.handling: Keep the catalog values as reference envelopes and verify exact connectors, firmware and mechanical envelope before releasing a build.

findings.issue: Pupper's USD 110 unit cost is an approximate public BOM value, not a verified current store quote.
findings.handling: Current quote remains null. USD 130 is a separate planning allowance; taxes, shipping, other robot parts and availability remain open.

findings.issue: A working Pupper and its air-cooled continuous-torque specification do not validate a different kitten body or enclosed actuator.
findings.handling: Do not claim policy transfer, kitten-scale fit, loaded response, thermal margin or complete kitten behavior from this selection.

remaining_work: mechanical layout and continuous pose clearance
result: Decision recorded consistently; physical feasibility and procurement readiness remain unverified.
